subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should OpenClaw core automatically replay hook output to explicit alternate destinations after primary delivery failure?
rationale: This adds public configuration and cross-channel recipient, authorization, retry, and duplication policy that cannot be settled safely from implementation details alone.

options.title: Explicit destination chain
options.body: Add ordered channel, target, account, and thread destinations with authorization checks, replay-safe failure classification, and duplicate prevention.

options.title: Failure notification only
options.body: Keep the original response single-target and use failureDestination to notify an operator separately.

options.title: No automatic replay
options.body: Require operators to configure independent hook workflows for each destination.

recommendation.title: Explicit destination chain
recommendation.body: Add ordered channel, target, account, and thread destinations with authorization checks, replay-safe failure classification, and duplicate prevention.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly refactored the hook-delivery surface and has already reviewed this issue's product boundary.
